subject: mathematics
introduction: Core formulas for CSEC Mathematics Paper 1 and Paper 2 — algebra, geometry, trigonometry, vectors, matrices, and statistics.

items.name: BODMAS order
items.notes: Apply left to right within each pair.

items.name: Percentage change
items.notes: Discount, profit, VAT and depreciation all use this form.

items.name: Simple interest
items.notes: P = principal, R = % rate, T = years. Amount = P + I.

items.name: Compound amounts
items.notes: Interest added each period; n = number of periods.

items.name: Ratio sharing
items.notes: Example: 3:2 split of 25 → boys = 3/5 × 25 = 15.

items.name: Direct / inverse proportion
items.notes: Find k from given values first, then solve for the unknown.

items.name: Standard form
items.notes: Move the decimal point; n counts the jumps (negative for small numbers).

items.name: HCF / LCM
items.formula: HCF: highest common factor; LCM: lowest common multiple
items.notes: Use prime-factor trees for larger numbers.

items.name: Quadratic standard form
items.notes: Solve by factoring, completing the square, or the formula below.

items.name: Quadratic formula
items.notes: Discriminant b²−4ac > 0: two roots; = 0: one; < 0: none real.

items.name: Difference of squares
items.notes: Example: x² − 9 = (x − 3)(x + 3).

items.name: Laws of indices
items.notes: Fractional powers: a^(1/n) = nth root of a.

items.name: Linear simultaneous equations
items.notes: Check by substituting both values into both equations.

items.name: Gradient / midpoint
items.notes: Parallel lines share m; perpendicular lines: m₁×m₂ = −1.

items.name: Straight line
items.notes: m = gradient, c = y-intercept. x-intercept: set y = 0.

items.name: Inequalities
items.formula: flip the sign when multiplying/dividing by a negative
items.notes: 'At most 5' means x ≤ 5; 'at least' means ≥.

items.name: Function notation
items.formula: f(x) means f of x; f(3) substitutes x = 3
items.notes: Example: f(x) = 2x+1 → f(3) = 7.

items.name: nth term (linear)
items.notes: a = common difference; find b by checking n = 1.

items.name: Geometric sequences
items.formula: multiply by a common ratio r each term

items.name: Transformations
items.notes: 90° clockwise about origin: (x, y) → (y, −x).

items.name: Interior angles
items.notes: Triangle: 180°; quadrilateral: 360°; pentagon: 540°; hexagon: 720°.

items.name: Pythagoras
items.notes: Use to find a missing side or check for a right angle.

items.name: SOH CAH TOA
items.formula: sin θ = opp/hyp; cos θ = adj/hyp; tan θ = opp/adj
items.notes: Special values: sin 30° = cos 60° = 0.5; tan 45° = 1.

items.name: Circle: circumference & area
items.notes: Sector area = (θ/360) × πr². Use π = 22/7 or 3.14 as instructed.

items.name: Rectangle / triangle
items.formula: A_rect = l × w, P = 2(l+w);  A_tri = ½ × b × h
items.notes: Diagonal of a rectangle via Pythagoras.

items.name: Cylinder / cube / cuboid
items.formula: V_cyl = πr²h;  V_cube = s³;  V_cuboid = l×w×h;  SA_cube = 6s²
items.notes: Watch units: volume in cm³, area in cm².

items.name: Circle theorems (key)
items.formula: angle in a semicircle = 90°; angles in the same segment are equal
items.notes: Radius meets a tangent at 90°.

items.name: Scale / maps
items.formula: real distance = map distance × scale factor
items.notes: Keep units consistent (cm → m → km).

items.name: Vector addition
items.notes: Subtract component-wise the same way; translation maps (x,y) → (x+a, y+b).

items.name: Singular matrix
items.notes: Check the determinant before attempting an inverse.

items.name: Mean
items.formula: mean = sum of values / number of values
items.notes: Find a missing value: total = mean × count.

items.name: Median / mode / range
items.formula: median = middle value (ordered); mode = most frequent; range = max − min
items.notes: Even count: median = average of the two middle values.

items.name: Probability scale
items.formula: P(E) = favourable outcomes / total outcomes;  0 ≤ P ≤ 1
items.notes: P(not E) = 1 − P(E). Two coins, exactly one head: 2/4 = 0.5.

items.name: Pie chart angles
items.notes: 40% of a pie chart = 144°.
